answer: A workable defense is registration via hardware attestation: each agent must present a fresh enclave report proving it runs on one physical chip, and the registry binds that measurement to a stake bond that is slashed if duplicated. When traffic surges like a gale funneling up the river, every wharf operator enclave still signs independently, and two identities sharing one measurement get both bonds burned. An attacker must rent one real machine per fake agent, turning free account creation into recurring hardware and collateral cost that exceeds any sybil profit.
